So the block screen can appear on top of other apps.
So your phone doesn\'t shut the app down in the background.
So reminders fire right on the minute.
24/7 uses Android\'s Accessibility service. It detects which app is currently open so it can block the apps you chose (for example Instagram or YouTube) during your routine.
24/7 only reads the name of the app that is currently open. Your typing, passwords and messages are never read. No data ever leaves your device. On the next screen, select «24/7» and turn it on.

Blocks the distracting apps you chose during your routine. It only reads the name of the app that is currently open. Screen text, typing, passwords and messages are never read. No data leaves your device.
Some phones shut down background apps, which stops blocking. Do these steps once:
Write down your daily routine — 24/7 will remind you and protect it.
In the evening you pick up your phone «for 5 minutes» and hours disappear.
The next morning you wake up late and the whole day falls apart.
At the time you set, 24/7 closes distracting apps and opens them again in the morning.
You can change it anytime in settings.
Select the apps to block during your routine.
Blocking needs 3 permissions. Everything stays on your phone.
Ongoing notification showing the routine is active
Routine time in %1$s. Start wrapping things up.
%1$s left. Get ready to put your phone down.
Good morning! You kept your routine — %1$s in a row.
New day, new plan. Shall we start?
This app is closed during your routine. Rest now — everything will be here in the morning.
Use this time to think: is it really necessary?
Not quite. Here\'s a new one.
You\'ve used all emergency access for today. Calls, SMS and the clock are always available.
24/7 only reads the name of the app that is currently open. Your typing, passwords and messages are never read. No data ever leaves your device, is sent to a server, or is shared with third parties.
The daily plans you enter, routine times, the list of blocked apps, reckoning marks and settings. All of it is stored only on your phone. The app has no sign-up, no ads and no internet permission.

The service knows only one thing: which app was just opened (its package name). This is needed to block the apps you chose during your routine. Screen text, typing, passwords, messages, images and other content are never read, stored or sent anywhere.

Display over other apps — for the block screen. Notifications and exact alarms — for reminders. Removing the battery restriction — so your phone doesn\'t stop the app in the background. The time your phone is unlocked — only for the «woke up on time» mark, on your phone. Approximate location — only to calculate prayer times on the phone; it is never sent anywhere. If you search for a city online (only when you tap “Search online”), the typed name is sent to Google through your phone’s location service.
No data is sold, shared with third parties or sent to any server. The app does not add data to cloud backups either.
Uninstalling the app or tapping «Clear data» in your phone settings permanently deletes all data.
If you have questions, write to the developer email listed on the Google Play page.

string-array.name: brand_steps_xiaomi
string-array.item: Settings → Apps → Manage apps → open 24/7.
Turn on «Autostart».
Battery saver → choose «No restrictions».
On the recent apps screen, pull the 24/7 card down and tap the lock icon.

string-array.name: brand_steps_samsung
string-array.item: Settings → Battery → Background usage limits.
Remove 24/7 from «Sleeping apps» and «Deep sleeping apps».
Add 24/7 to «Never sleeping apps».
Settings → Apps → 24/7 → Battery → choose «Unrestricted».

string-array.name: brand_steps_huawei
string-array.item: Settings → Battery → App launch.
Find 24/7 and switch off automatic management (Manage manually).
In the dialog, turn on all three: Auto-launch, Secondary launch, Run in background.
Lock 24/7 on the recent apps screen.

string-array.name: brand_steps_oppo
string-array.item: Settings → Battery → More settings → Optimize background activity.
Choose «Don\'t optimize» for 24/7.
Settings → App management → 24/7 → allow «Auto launch».
Lock 24/7 on the recent apps screen.

string-array.name: brand_steps_vivo
string-array.item: Settings → Battery → High background power consumption.
Allow 24/7 to run in the background.
i Manager → App manager → Autostart → turn on 24/7.
Lock 24/7 on the recent apps screen.

string-array.name: brand_steps_oneplus
string-array.item: Settings → Battery → Battery optimization.
24/7 → choose «Don\'t optimize».
Settings → Apps → 24/7 → Battery → turn on «Allow background activity».
Lock 24/7 on the recent apps screen.

string-array.name: brand_steps_other
string-array.item: Settings → Apps → 24/7 → Battery.
Choose «Unrestricted» or «Don\'t optimize».
If there is an «Autostart» section, turn it on for 24/7.
Check that every item in the list above is green.

string-array.name: muhosaba_quotes
string-array.item: Take account of yourselves before you are taken to account, and weigh your deeds before they are weighed for you.
O son of Adam, you are but a number of days. Whenever a day passes, a part of you passes with it.
A servant will not be God-fearing until he takes account of himself the way he takes account of his business partner.
The believer watches over his own soul and takes it to account for the sake of Allah. The reckoning on the Day of Resurrection will be light for those who took account of themselves in this world.
When evening comes, do not wait for the morning; when morning comes, do not wait for the evening. Take from your health for your illness, and from your life for your death.
There are two blessings in which many people are cheated: health and free time.

The feet of a servant will not move on the Day of Resurrection until he is asked about his life and how he spent it, his knowledge and what he did with it, his wealth — where he earned it and how he spent it — and his body and how he wore it out.
O you who believe! Fear Allah, and let every soul look to what it has sent ahead for tomorrow.
I met people who were more careful with their time than you are with your dirhams and dinars.

string-array.name: azkar_quotes
string-array.item: «So remember Me; I will remember you.» — Surah al-Baqarah, 2:152
«Verily, in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.» — Surah ar-Raʼd, 13:28
«O you who believe, remember Allah with much remembrance and glorify Him morning and evening.» — Surah al-Ahzab, 33:41–42
«Glorify the praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting.» — Surah Ta-Ha, 20:130
«The example of the one who remembers his Lord and the one who does not is like the living and the dead.» — al-Bukhari (6407)
«Whoever says “Subhan Allahi wa bihamdihi” a hundred times a day, his sins are erased even if they are like the foam of the sea.» — al-Bukhari and Muslim
«Let your tongue remain moist with the remembrance of Allah.» — at-Tirmidhi (3375)
«Remembrance is to the heart what water is to a fish. How would a fish be if it left the water?» — Ibn Taymiyyah (in Ibn al-Qayyim, al-Wabil as-Sayyib)
